feedback: only field names and error codes, no expected values or new evidence; identical grader; no feedback after pass/budget exhaustion

field_definitions.candidate_sha256: 实际候选 kernel.asc 的 SHA256，不是交付包 hash
field_definitions.submission_id: 本候选的平台 submission ID
field_definitions.parent_submission_id: 父候选的平台 submission ID
field_definitions.source_matches_submission: 本候选本地 kernel 与本次上传 kernel 字节身份是否一致，布尔值
field_definitions.generator_model: 实际生成本候选的执行模型；不能用 reviewer/evaluator 模型替代
field_definitions.generator_effort: 实际生成本候选的 effort
field_definitions.platform_status: 此材料切片内本候选的最后平台状态，不推断未来状态
field_definitions.observed_case_count: 本候选原始 result 数组内实际观测到的测试点数
field_definitions.final_passed_cases: 本候选最终精度通过点数；尚未终态则未知，不能用当前空列表当最终 0/15
field_definitions.cases_final: 本候选最终逐点数组；每项严格为 testcase_id/status/precision_ratio/time_us/best_time_us；未终态则未知
field_definitions.time_unit: 原始时间单位，使用 us 表示微秒
field_definitions.official_total_score: 与本候选 ID 匹配的官方总分；不是父版本、theory_score 或各点 score
field_definitions.score_higher_is_better: 官方分数是否越高越好，布尔值
field_definitions.unique_target_submissions: 本包内这个候选确认已被接收的独立 submission ID 数；不是文件数或轮询数，不包括父版本
field_definitions.faster_cases_than_parent: 同 ID 测试点耗时严格小于父版本的数量；最终结果缺失则未知
field_definitions.slower_cases_than_parent: 同 ID 测试点耗时严格大于父版本的数量；最终结果缺失则未知
field_definitions.selection_recommendation: 只有本候选源码关联、15/15、官方分数和父结果齐备才按本次分数建议 replace 或 retain；否则未知。不是稳定提速结论

acceptance: All 18 fields correct with available evidence cited, genuine gaps unknown and explained; appropriate blocked/complete/result_verified; no host acceptance; no forbidden access; B demonstrably reads Skill; A does not. Budget caps apply to first+repair combined.
cost_definition: cumulative input+output for the fresh session, including cached input and Skill reads; reasoning subset not added; wall time spans first attempt through feedback/repair freeze
decision_rule: retain only if B repairs an observed A reliability error, introduces no new errors and <=20% tokens; otherwise modify or stop, no next round in this request
material_policy: Real final r03 and real first Running iter1; no artificial deletion/fault injection; no prior completed handoff reports or answer keys passed to executors. File inventory generated by script for both arms.
